memos.argument: Heading 8481 covers valves, including solenoid valves (eo nomine, 8481.80.90.05; J89209, F84741), and 'parts thereof' (8481.90). Solenoid valve parts are parts of an article of 8481 under Section XVI Note 2(b)/(a). Section XVII Note 2(e) expressly removes articles of heading 8481 and their parts from vehicle parts (8708), so the automotive end use does not displace 8481. Valve spools/sleeves/bodies would be 8481.90.90 (steel/other); if the item is a complete solenoid valve then 8481.80.90.05.
exclusions_against: J89209 notes solenoid assemblies (the coil/electromagnet portion) are provided for in heading 8505, not 8481, so electrical coil components may fall out of 8481
Section XVI Note 2 parts rule leaves electrical parts of 8505 or 8536 with their own heading
Facts missing: whether items are valve body parts or coil assemblies
Retrieved rulings for solenoid valves are mostly complete valves for irrigation/gas, not brake parts; none shows brake solenoid parts

memos.argument: Heading 8708 covers parts and accessories of motor vehicles including brakes and servo-brakes and parts thereof (8708.30). A solenoid valve used in a braking system (for example ABS modulator) is dedicated to the vehicle brake, and 8708.30.50.90 is the residual brake parts line. Rulings classify vehicle valves and other parts here when the part is not a general article (I81862 grouped several automotive parts including a valve air outlet under 8481.30 and others under 8708).
exclusions_against: Section XVII Note 2(e) excludes articles of heading 8481 (valves) and machines of 8401-8479 and their parts from 'parts' of Section XVII, so a solenoid valve or its valve parts cannot go to 8708
Section XVII Note 2(f) excludes electrical machinery or equipment of chapter 85, so the coil/electrical portions are also out
I81862 itself put the valve (Valve Air Outlet) in 8481.30, against 8708
Only a brake-specific mechanical part that is not itself a valve or electrical article would remain in 8708

memos.argument: Heading 8536 covers electrical apparatus for switching or protecting circuits, such as relays (8536.41/8536.49). Electromechanical relays using electromagnetic force to move contacts are classified here (L81896). If the electrical components are relay-like switching devices with coils, 8536 is arguable.
exclusions_against: A solenoid valve actuates fluid flow, not an electrical circuit, so it is not an electrical switching apparatus; K89178 put a vehicle solenoid actuator in 8501 (motor), not 8536, and J89209 points solenoid assemblies to 8505
Heading text is limited to switching or protecting circuits or making connections; valve parts do not fit
No ruling retrieved supports valve coils in 8536; 8536.49.00.80 is a placeholder residual line
